criteria.text: Treatment plan, clinical evidence-based rationale and demonstration of medical necessity submitted.
Prescriber attests to checking the PDMP.
Patient has a seizure diagnosis and needs dosing above Table 1 limits and/or more than one benzodiazepine per month.
The request does not combine Table 1 quantity-limit exceedance with concurrent opioids. Answer Yes if within Table 1 limits OR no concurrent opioids; No if both exceeding limits and taking opioids.

notes: Partial encoding of class quantity-limit / therapeutic-duplication PA criteria for listed oral agents only: alprazolam (including XR/ER, ODT and Intensol), chlordiazepoxide, clonazepam (including ODT), clorazepate, diazepam (including Intensol), estazolam, flurazepam, lorazepam (including Intensol), oxazepam, quazepam, temazepam and triazolam. Rules engine is the sole eligibility evaluator.

The seizure diagnosis alternate path bypasses treatment-plan and PDMP gates. Source criterion 3 uses "and" between exceeding Table 1 limits and needing more than one benzodiazepine per month; the requested interpretation encodes and/or. The opioid-plus-quantity-exceedance denial still applies to every path, including seizure and therapeutic duplication. Concurrent opioids alone do not trigger this denial. Prescriber is encouraged to consider reducing benzodiazepine and/or opioid dosages.
Duration (notes only): initial approval up to 3 months; re-authorization up to 12 months with clinically meaningful chart notes showing positive response to therapy.
